name: spharmgrid
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  python_min: "3.11"
  version: "0.1.2"

package:
  name: spharmgrid
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/spharmgrid/spharmgrid-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 757c9a0d4f62ad67069b91991b33d4f99ccd9f4eb22763b2519d8519fadad353

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - spharmgrid = spharmgrid.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling >=1.27
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - ducc0 >=0.39.0
    - numpy >=1.26.0
    - xarray >=2024.9.0
  run_constraints:
    - cf-xarray >=0.10.4
    - dask-core >=2024.1.0
    - h5netcdf >=1.8.0
    - h5py >=3.11.0
    - zarr >=3.0.0
    - cfgrib >=0.9.15
    - python-eccodes >=2.48.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - spharmgrid
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - spharmgrid --help

about:
  summary: Spherical harmonic tools for filtering, regridding, and kinematics in atmospheric science with Xarray
  description: |
    spharmgrid (spherical harmonic gridding) implements spherical harmonic
    filtering, regridding, differential operators, and atmospheric wind
    diagnostics for global xarray fields. It computes relative vorticity,
    divergence, streamfunction, velocity potential, Helmholtz decomposition,
    and inverse wind transforms.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/spharmgrid/
  documentation: https://spharmgrid.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/mwyau/spharmgrid

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mwyau
